limitations: Default is unchanged. Optional Ruiz counts remain experimental; eight and twelve fail the N20 pilot, and one pass fails two longer-comparison samples.

Empty equilibration denominators at or below the existing 1e-15 threshold use identity scaling. Inverse-scale reciprocal arithmetic is unchanged; arbitrary extreme-range coefficients are not exhaustively covered.
N500 pilot has only three measured samples per count; no general latency or throughput improvement is claimed.
Planner77 links unchanged core72, and v78 retains optional v76 graphs/deferred transposes. This is not a change to the selected production backend.
Initial GPU Ruiz work is included in QOCO setup time; later work is included in QOCO update time. The separate legacy scaling_seconds field does not isolate QOCO equilibration.
Initial CPU setup, host solver/SCvx decisions, CPU independent replay and wider mission/batching work remain.
Lambda campaigns were not queried or modified during this tranche. Last separate read-only observation remains in lambda-status-2026-09-06-followup.json.
sanitizer_scope: All four tools on ten zero-norm fixtures, nine nondegenerate update-oracle fixtures, and N20 one-pass full trajectory. N500 one-pass full trajectory uses memory/init/sync only; no N500 racecheck. Full trajectory results also pass the fixed objective gate.
